summary.text: Anthony Airdo is the Republican candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 77 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Norma Hernandez (D).
Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, each time losing the general election.

paragraphs.text: Airdo ran unopposed in the Republican primary for District 77 in 2016 and lost the general election to incumbent Kathleen Willis (D).
He advanced from the Republican primary again in 2018 and 2020 and lost the general election to Willis each time.
In 2022 Airdo advanced from the Republican primary and lost the general election to Norma Hernandez (D), and he lost to Hernandez again in 2024.
He won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary for a sixth run for the seat.
Ballotpedia notes that he has not completed its 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
